name: Bioinorganic Chemistry
summary: The roles of metal ions in biology and medicine, from oxygen transport to nitrogen fixation.

topics.name: Metals in biology: essential elements, uptake, transport and storage
Oxygen transport: hemoglobin, myoglobin and hemocyanin
Electron-transfer proteins: cytochromes, iron-sulfur clusters and blue copper
Metalloenzymes: nitrogenase, hydrogenase, cytochrome P450 and methane monooxygenase
Photosystem II and the oxygen-evolving complex
Zinc enzymes and structural metal sites
Metals in medicine: platinum drugs, gadolinium contrast, metal toxicity and chelation therapy
